content:
Excellent! Let's modify `ISOFormEditorView.jsx` using `multi_replace_file_content`. We'll:
1. Define `getCurrentFormattedDateTime` at the top.
2. Initialize `issue_date` to `getCurrentFormattedDateTime()`.
3. In `useEffect` generic check, set `issue_date` to `getCurrentFormattedDateTime()`.
4. In `fetchDocDetails`, set `issue_date` to `getCurrentFormattedDateTime()`.
5. Update JSX to make input read-only, type="text" and styled beautifully.

args.Description: Update 'Ngày cập nhật' field in ISOFormEditorView to retrieve the current date/time with hour/minute and make it read-only.
args.Instruction: Add getCurrentFormattedDateTime, update state initialization, generic parser effect, details fetch, and JSX rendering.

ReplacementChunks.ReplacementContent:
symbol: '',
    version: '01',
    issue_date: getCurrentFormattedDateTime(),
    issuer: loggedInUser.full_name || '',
ReplacementChunks.TargetContent:
symbol: '',
    version: '01',
    issue_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
    issuer: loggedInUser.full_name || '',

ReplacementChunks.ReplacementContent:
version: parsed.version || '01',
          issue_date: getCurrentFormattedDateTime(),
          file_path: parsed.file_path || '',
ReplacementChunks.TargetContent:
version: parsed.version || '01',
          issue_date: parsed.issue_date || new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
          file_path: parsed.file_path || '',

ReplacementChunks.ReplacementContent:
<input 
                    type="text" 
                    value={formData.issue_date} 
                    readOnly
                    placeholder="Ngày cập nhật..."
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '36px', padding: '8px 12px', border: '1px solid #E5E7EB', borderRadius: '6px', fontSize: '0.82rem', outline: 'none', fontWeight: '600', backgroundColor: '#F3F4F6', color: '#4B5563', cursor: 'not-allowed' }} 
                  />
ReplacementChunks.TargetContent:
<input 
                    type="date" 
                    value={formData.issue_date} 
                    onChange={(e) => handleInputChange('issue_date', e.target.value)} 
                    style={{ width: '100%', height: '36px', padding: '8px 12px', border: '1px solid #D1D5DB', borderRadius: '6px', fontSize: '0.82rem', outline: 'none', color: '#1F2937' }} 
                  />

args.toolAction: Updating Ngày cập nhật in ISOFormEditorView
